Today my cousin and I visited a pottery workshop. We arrived early, before the other visitors. (1) ____ The teacher opened it at ten and invited everyone in.

First, she gave each of us a piece of soft clay. I wanted to make a tall cup, but its sides kept falling down. (2) ____ This time I made a small bowl with a wide bottom. It stayed in shape.

Before lunch, we put our names under the bowls. We could not take them home that day because they still needed to be fired. (3) ____ I wrote the date in my diary so that I would not forget.

In the afternoon, we looked at finished pottery in the shop. I liked a blue plate, but I decided not to buy it. (4) ____ I wanted to leave enough money for the bus home. I was happy to have made something of my own, even though I would have to wait to collect it.

filled_article:
### August 8

Today my cousin and I visited a pottery workshop. We arrived early, before the other visitors. The doors were still closed when we got there. The teacher opened it at ten and invited everyone in.

First, she gave each of us a piece of soft clay. I wanted to make a tall cup, but its sides kept falling down. I asked for fresh clay and tried a simpler shape. This time I made a small bowl with a wide bottom. It stayed in shape.

Before lunch, we put our names under the bowls. We could not take them home that day because they still needed to be fired. We were told to return the following Saturday. I wrote the date in my diary so that I would not forget.

In the afternoon, we looked at finished pottery in the shop. I liked a blue plate, but I decided not to buy it. It cost more than the money I had left for shopping. I wanted to leave enough money for the bus home. I was happy to have made something of my own, even though I would have to wait to collect it.
